provenance.title: Ludiko short English reading texts with comprehension questions (grades III-IV)
provenance.author: Ludiko
provenance.notes: Ten original texts of 30-70 words (no textbook or exam text). British English. 'a' is the correct answer (it appears in the text, ignoring a leading 'a'), 'x' the wrong options; type 'tf' questions give an English statement 's' and its truth value. Awaiting review by an English teacher.

texts.title: My family
texts.text: My name is Ana. I am eight years old. I live in a small house with my mum, my dad and my brother Tom. We have a cat. Its name is Mimi. Mimi is white and she likes milk. I love my family.

q.s: Ana lives in a big house.

texts.title: A sunny Saturday
texts.text: It is Saturday today. The weather is sunny. Ben and his sister Mia are in the park. Ben plays football with his friends. Mia sits on the swing. After that they eat ice cream. The ice cream is cold and sweet. They are very happy.

q.ro: Ce zi a săptămânii este azi?

texts.title: My new bag
texts.text: I have got a new school bag. It is blue and red. In my bag I have got two books, a pencil, a ruler and a small apple. My friend Dan has got a green bag. His bag is old, but he likes it. We go to school together every morning.

q.en: What colours is the new bag?
How many books are in the bag?
Who has got a green bag?

texts.title: On the farm
texts.text: Mr Hill is a farmer. He has got a big farm with six cows, ten hens and two horses. Every morning he gets up at five o'clock. He gives milk to the cat and food to the hens. In the evening he goes to bed early.

q.en: How many cows has he got?
What time does he get up?

texts.title: My room
texts.text: My room is small but nice. There is a bed, a desk and a lamp in it. The bed is next to the window. My teddy bear is on the bed. My books are on the desk. I like my room because it is quiet.

q.en: Why does the writer like the room?

q.s: The books are under the bed.
There is a lamp in the room.

texts.title: Sofia's week
texts.text: Hello! My name is Sofia and I am nine years old. I live in Sibiu, a city in Romania. I go to school from Monday to Friday. My favourite subject is English because I like singing songs and playing word games. After school I do my homework, and then I play with my dog, Rex. On Sundays we visit my grandparents.

q.s: Sofia goes to school on Saturday.
On Sundays they visit the grandparents.

texts.title: A day at the zoo
texts.text: Today our class is at the zoo. We can see lions, monkeys and a very tall giraffe. The monkeys are funny because they jump from tree to tree. The lion is sleeping, so it is quiet. At twelve o'clock we eat our sandwiches in the park. Then we take the bus back to school.

q.en: What time do they eat the sandwiches?

q.s: The children go back to school by bus.

texts.title: Seasons in Romania
texts.text: In winter it is cold in Romania. There is a lot of snow, and the children make a snowman. They wear warm coats, hats, scarves and gloves. In summer it is hot and sunny. People go to the sea and eat ice cream. My favourite season is autumn, because the leaves are red and yellow.

q.en: What do the children make in winter?

q.ro: Care este anotimpul preferat al autorului?
q.en: What is the writer's favourite season?

q.ro: De ce culori sunt frunzele toamna?
q.en: What colour are the leaves in autumn?

q.s: People eat ice cream in summer.

texts.title: Tom's new pet
texts.text: Tom wants a pet. His mum says no, but his dad says yes. On Saturday they go to a small shop and look at the animals. There are fish, birds and rabbits. Tom chooses a white rabbit with long ears. He calls it Snow. Now Snow lives in a big box in Tom's room and eats carrots every day.

q.ro: Ce mănâncă iepurele în fiecare zi?
q.en: What does the rabbit eat every day?

q.s: The rabbit has got long ears.

texts.title: A busy day
texts.text: Maya has got a busy day. She gets up at half past six and has breakfast at seven. School starts at eight o'clock. She has English on Tuesday and Thursday. After school she goes to the library, and at five o'clock she plays the piano. She goes to bed at nine.

q.ro: La ce oră se trezește Maya?
q.en: What time does Maya get up?

q.ro: Ce face Maya la ora cinci?
q.en: What does Maya do at five o'clock?
On which days does she have English?

q.s: She goes to bed at nine.
